_doc: THE ONE record of the production database volume's PROVISIONED size, read by scripts/n5_capacity.py and nothing else. It is NOT the database size, free space, used space, the dashboard percentage, the object Storage quota, or an estimate. Read it from Supabase -> Project Settings -> Compute and Disk. provisioned_disk = the volume size shown there. non_database_usage = that page's USED figure minus pg_database_size minus WAL, read at the same moment (0 is allowed only if that is what the arithmetic gives). Every quantity needs an explicit unit: MiB | GiB | MB | GB (MB and GB are DECIMAL; record the dashboard's 'GB' as "GB" unless it says GiB). observed_at is when YOU read the dashboard, ISO-8601 with a timezone. Readings expire after 24 hours, and are honoured only in a GitHub Actions run on main. null means NOT RECORDED, and every gated builder REFUSES until it is recorded.
notes: 2026-09-24: founder reported the volume 69% utilized with ~11 GB database + ~1 GB WAL and CPU ~100%, and held the N5 candidate build. The provisioned size itself was not stated, so it is left unrecorded rather than back-derived from a percentage.
